asphalt.description: Dry fine aggregate asphalt; subtle 0.2–2m patches, no invented lane wear.

concrete.description: Unpainted exterior concrete, small pores and low-contrast mottling.

paving_stone.description: Meter-scale neutral slabs; joints are texture relief, not certified construction joints.

brick.description: Running-bond yellow/red masonry. Actual building brick color remains approximate.

stucco.description: Mineral stucco and matte exterior coating, finer than concrete.

paint.description: Coated opaque surface, nonmetal even when applied over metal.

glass.description: Tinted dielectric glazing. Transmission uses KHR_materials_transmission; fallback is opaque tinted dielectric, not metal.

metal.description: Uncoated brushed aluminum/steel approximation; paint uses separate dielectric material.

roof.description: Dry mineral roofing membrane distinct from vertical concrete and ground asphalt.

soil.description: Dry exposed earth, not a measured soil survey or displacement terrain.

grass.description: Low ground vegetation surface, distant representation rather than individual grass blades.

leaf.description: Original generic oval leaf with veins; shape/tree species are inferred, alpha from base-color texture.

water.description: Distant river/sea surface approximation. Wave normal is not water-level displacement; no fabricated bathymetry.

road_marking.description: Neutral dry lane/crosswalk paint with modest granularity; yellow variant tints base factor.
